scope: Focused collector regression using synthetic files in isolated temporary directories. These are not new coding-agent or task-verifier runs.
behaviors: A corrected-verifier native failure cannot inherit a historical passing rescore
A different episode cannot overwrite a curated archive
Original affected episodes require a rescore of the same source patch and revision
Valid original same-patch rescoring remains supported
Finalizing new corrected-verifier episodes does not require historical rescoring
